title: PAF Verification Execution Model (Step 13)
description: Turns a verification map into executable, recordable behavior WITHOUT altering requirement wording. The map says what must be verified; this model says how a verification is executed, recorded, and counted as satisfied.

wordingImmutable.const: The execution model never alters, paraphrases, or reinterprets requirement wording. It attaches execution behavior to it.

unmappedIsGap.const: A decision with no mapped verification mechanism is a governance coverage gap, not a satisfied requirement.

mappedIsNotImplemented.const: A mapped mechanism does not count as implemented until the framework actually provides it and evidence can be linked to it.

evidenceLinkable.const: A verification is satisfied only when a concrete evidence record can be resolved from the decision identifier.

statusModel.description: The progression every governed decision moves through. Advancing a status without its evidence is a fabricated completion.

satisfiesIndependenceAlone.description: Only deterministic non-judgmental checks may be true here. Agent judgment never satisfies independence on its own.

records.description: Populated at Profile binding. Each entry binds one governed decision to its execution behavior.
